scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "bun run client:watch" "bun run server:dev"
scripts.client:watch: bun build src/index.tsx --target browser --format esm --outdir dist --watch
scripts.build: bun build src/index.tsx --target browser --format esm --outdir dist --minify && cp index.html src/styles.css dist/
scripts.gate: bun run typecheck && bun run test
